race.comment: DEFIANT CODE (18) makes strong appeal off a close debut sixth at Doomben where he was charging hard late. This doesn't look as tough and the weight relief adds to the case despite the awkward draw. IT'SALL ABOUT MARY (12) has the race experience and recent consistency, missing by a nose at Kilcoy. Gets in light with the claimer engaged and looms the immediate threat. HIT A LICK (11) comes through a good Doomben third at long odds. Expect them to apply positive tactics again. TILLYS LAST WISH (16) is the key debut danger after winning two trials, including one on the Inner Track. The inside draw gives her every chance to convert.
